name: Concentration

subjectOf.text: The DeFi lending market is highly concentrated: MakerDAO alone accounts for almost ninety percent of the total USD value locked in DeFi projects.
subjectOf.abstract: MakerDAO accounts for almost ninety percent of total USD value locked in DeFi projects.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Digital Asset Market Evolution (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3606663
scope_conditions: DeFi projects measured by total USD value locked
period covered by DeFi Pulse data

subjectOf.text: Concentration produces instability and dispersion produces stability: the more concentrated a structure is, the more unstable it is, because little changes can cause major structural change, while a spread out pattern remains spread out when disturbed.
subjectOf.abstract: The more concentrated a structure is, the more unstable it is. The more spread out a pattern is, the more stable it is
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Preface to (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782191
scope_conditions: any structure characterized by concentration or dispersion

subjectOf.text: Those few entities and individuals who control the data flow and the associated algorithms can use centralized algorithmic human predictors to build autocratic algorithmic systems and structures, and the implied loss of democratic principles in society is perhaps an inevitable side effect.
subjectOf.abstract: Centralized algorithmic human predictors can be used by those few entities and individuals who control the data flow and the associated algorithms to create autocratic algorithmic systems and structures. The implied loss of democratic principles in society is perhaps an inevitable side effect.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How Decentralized Systems Can Upgrade AI (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808867
scope_conditions: concentrated control over data flows and algorithms

subjectOf.text: The high cost of processing colossal datasets confines frontier AI innovation to a small number of well-resourced institutions.
subjectOf.abstract: the high costs associated with processing colossal datasets restrict such innovation to a handful of well-resourced institutions.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Artificial Intelligence The Final Frontier (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5095633
scope_conditions: applies where model development requires processing very large datasets
